name: Brain Dump Journaling Before Bed
instructions: Spend 5-10 minutes writing down anything on your mind -- tomorrow's to-do list, unresolved worries, or just how the day went.
Do not try to solve anything while writing; the goal is just to get it out of your head and onto paper.
Close the notebook when you're done as a physical cue that you're setting those thoughts aside for the night.
Follow with tonight's guided deep sleep meditation to settle in.
